---
title: "Lab: Data wrangling II: joins, reshaping & de-duplication"
---

**Data:** WHO tuberculosis data (`tidyr::who2`, `tidyr::population`); `medicaldata::covid_testing` (repeat tests)

## Learning goals
- Choose the right join for a question
- Reshape between long and wide formats
- Join case counts to population to compute incidence rates
- Remove duplicate records and keep one row per person
